checkpoints: After each editor edit, the document's 120 ms trailing task is pending with the latest text for that document.
At the 120 ms quiet-interval boundary, the trailing task clears its pending state before invoking the store write, allowing later edits—even during synchronous callbacks—to form a new burst.
After a burst saves, a later edit schedules another save and is not suppressed by prior completion.

forbidden_effects: Do not write editor text to the store on every keystroke.
Do not emit more than one store write for one uninterrupted editing burst.
Do not cancel or discard a document's pending save merely because its view closes, navigates, or its Badge detaches.
Do not let one document's edits replace, cancel, or flush another document's pending text.

lifecycle_identity: Each document id has a coordinator-owned trailing buffer retained in the Workspace dictionary and reused when that id is reopened.
A Badge represents only the current live view and subscription; detaching it must not destroy the document buffer.
Preview owns a separate transient trailing task with a distinct 40 ms quiet interval.
Workspace generation/current-view state continues to govern view lifecycle independently of document-buffer lifetime.

obligations.text: Workspace#edit must enqueue the current view's text into that document's existing Trailing task instead of calling the store write immediately.
For edits to one document within an uninterrupted burst, reset the trailing timer on each edit and, after 120 ms without another edit, write exactly the latest text once.
After a trailing save completes, subsequent editing bursts must schedule and complete further saves.
Document trailing tasks must be keyed by document id in the coordinator dictionary so different documents have independent pending values and timers, and reopening a document reuses its buffer.
Pending document saves must survive Badge detachment, close, and navigation because document-buffer ownership is independent of the current view.
The trailing task must clear its handle and pending value before invoking the write callback, preserving correctness when synchronous store listeners navigate or initiate later activity.
Preserve the existing Workspace, Badge, Store, Trailing, and host-facing public interfaces and preserve document/status event semantics apart from the required delayed coalescing of editor writes.
Leave the adjacent Preview implementation and its 40 ms trailing/cancel behavior unchanged.

ordering_barriers: Within a document burst: accept edit text, cancel the prior timer if present, replace the pending value, then schedule a fresh 120 ms timer.

View retirement detaches the old Badge subscription and emits the nil document output, but does not cancel or remove its coordinator-owned document buffer.
Opening retains the existing retire/create/output ordering while selecting or creating the id-keyed document buffer.

interval, write only the latest text in that editing burst.

def get(env,id);@entries[id] ||= Trailing.new(env,120) {|text| env.write(id,text)};end
buffer=(@buffers[id] ||= Trailing.new(@env,120){|text| @env.write(id,text)});@current=Badge.new(@env,id,buffer);@env.output('document',{'id'=>id,'text'=>@env.store.read(id)})
def edit(text);view=@current;@env.write(view.id,text) if view;end

def initialize(env);@task=Trailing.new(env,40){|q| env.output('preview',{'query'=>q})};end
 def query(text);@task.push(text);end
 def hide;@task.cancel;end
